_comment: UNSTAMPED 2026-09-10 /innovate ledger. Verdicts are stamped by falsification.py --run-ledger, never by hand. Polarity: predicate TRUE = disproving evidence found = killed. Each kill-test is that claim's OWN disproof; no test is reused across candidates.

candidates.claim: Reading the single-class CDC AR Bank cohorts ONE-SIDED (all-R sets measure sensitivity, all-S sets measure specificity) is an unexploited move that turns 12 'unusable' cohorts into usable evidence.

The one-sided AR Bank numbers were computed and committed but are stamped hard_fail/run_degraded and never reach the standing trust surface, so validated evidence exists that no consumer of the report card can see.

The L2 completeness screen is structurally unreachable for every BACTERIAL target-site cell: target_site_doubt returns early when doubt_cell_for(drug) is None, so a substitution at an uncatalogued codon gets a false clean bill.

The project's own source-concentration bar (which REFUSED to report 6 of 10 frozen SCORED cells) was never applied to the AR Bank arm, whose cohorts are single curated deposits and which reports the project's highest accuracies.

The discriminating variable for de-confounded learned decoding is causal-variant-to-clade COUPLING, not population design: horizontally mobile determinants survive lineage correction (HGT is nature's randomization) while chromosomal ones collapse.

Decoder errors on the AR Bank panel are ISOLATE-clustered rather than drug-independent, so some error mass currently attributed to catalog gaps is assembly/sample quality and is recoverable as a per-isolate trust signal.

Mean-pooling is the mechanism behind the 0-for-5: it weights each causal gene ~1/N_genes so the pooled vector's leading direction is ancestry by construction, meaning LOCUS RESOLUTION rather than population design is the necessary condition for a de-confounded positive.
